data.raw_text:
OGs in the space will definitely be familiar with the great Venom Blockchain.

The ecosystem is taking great shape with a lot of updates and actions from the team and I'm here to bring you insights.
 
But here's a little intro for new chads...

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐕𝐞𝐧𝐨𝐦?

@Venom_network_ is a high-performance blockchain designed as both a layer-0 and layer-1 network, built to support large-scale, enterprise-grade applications.

It uses an asynchronous, sharded architecture that allows multiple transactions and processes to run in parallel, giving it massive throughput and extremely low fees.

A lot of people have slept on the project as a whole but it’s amazing how the team continues to forge ahead with initiatives that are growth centric and fosters crypto adoption.

These include amazing onchain implementations like:

• 𝐋𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐬 & 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐬𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲

Venom is engineered to keep transaction costs extremely low, even during periods of high network activity.

Its architecture ensures that performance stays smooth as usage increases, making it ideal for large-scale applications.

• 𝐃𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐜 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥-𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐬𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 

The network automatically splits into new shards as demand rises, preventing congestion before it happens.

This allows Venom to scale instantly and maintain fast, consistent transaction speeds.

• 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝𝐦𝐚𝐩 𝐭𝐨 𝟓𝟎𝟎,𝟎𝟎𝟎 𝐝𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐲 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬

Venom is actively optimizing its infrastructure to sustainably handle half a million transactions per day.

This goal reflects their ambition to support real-world national and enterprise-level systems.

The teams has also worked out amazing partnerships and community building plans including:

• 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐃𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧

Venom is building blockchain infrastructure to support the Philippines’ transition into a fully digital government ecosystem.

This includes secure data systems, digital identity, and scalable public services.

• 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚

The project is onboarding African developers and institutions to build localized solutions on the Venom network.

This expansion positions Venom as a foundational layer for the continent’s digital transformation.

• 𝐔𝐀𝐄 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐭 𝐒𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐦

In partnership with the UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, Venom is developing a blockchain-based carbon credit framework.

This system aims to improve transparency, traceability, and efficiency in environmental reporting.

• 𝐍𝐞𝐠𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐲

Venom is in advanced talks with a major Chinese fintech player to integrate blockchain into large-scale financial operations.

If finalized, this partnership could significantly expand adoption in Asia’s largest digital payments market.

One thing is sure, the @venomfoundation is cooking and it’s only a matter of time before the world catches up.
#BingXSpotBlast
